summary: Record an artifacts cache usage event
description: Records an artifacts cache usage event. The body of this request is an array of cache usage events. The supported event types are `HIT` and `MISS`. The source is either `LOCAL` the cache event was on the users filesystem cache or `REMOTE` if the cache event is for a remote cache. When the event is a `HIT` the request also accepts a number `duration` which is the time taken to generate the artifact
Uploads a cache artifact identified by the `hash` specified on the path. The cache artifact can then be downloaded with the provided `hash`.
